source_of_truth: Supabase patch_log table (mirrored here for offline reference)

patches.name: Patch 0 — Architectural Simplification
patches.summary: Meta-analysis: collapse to 4 planes + 1 event spine. GRID = view-projection only. All modules = cartridges. Governs all architecture decisions.
patches.notes: Read-only. Shapes all other patches. Key rule: no new systems outside the 4-plane model.

patches.name: Patch 1 — Intake Pipeline
patches.summary: intake/gpt/ folder structure for AI handoff review lane.

patches.name: Patch 2 — GB Emulator Stubs
patches.summary: ROMLoader + EmulatorRouter architecture stubs. GBA header detection via ARM reset vector (0x2E 0x00 0x00 0xEA).
patches.notes: Architecture only — no engine. GL7 compliant.

patches.name: Patch 3 — EMULATOR UI
patches.summary: EMULATOR menu item (7th), ROM file picker, handleROM() FileReader, detection feedback screen. B=stop+back, A=load.
patches.notes: Engine displays 'NOT YET INTEGRATED' until P06 engine is chosen.

patches.name: Patch 4 — Neural Mesh (critical)
patches.summary: sessions/events/memory_state Supabase tables. ModeController. startSession/updateSession/sbEvent wiring. Realtime connected.

patches.name: Patch 5 — GRID Spatial Graph (critical)
patches.summary: L0 spatial graph (16 nodes), L2 field overlay (glow/pressure from node_fields), L3 vector routing (SVG arrowheads). L4 Hypergraph + L5 Temporal pending.
remaining: L4 Hypergraph — patch lineage + multi-node decisions
L5 Temporal — GitHub versioning + snapshot replay

patches.name: Patch 6 — Master Emulator Consolidation (critical)
patches.summary: RetroArch-style unified emulator. Adapter pattern. Local-first ROM execution. GB/GBC/GBA under one interface.
patches.notes: Blocked until emulator engine chosen (WasmBoy, Emulicious WASM, or custom).

patches.name: Patch 7 — GRID Execution Bridge
patches.summary: Bridge between GRID node state and emulator execution context.

patches.name: Patch 8 — GitHub ROM Indexer
patches.summary: Auto-index ROMs in repo via GitHub API. Feed into GRID node list.

patches.name: Patch 9 — Save States
patches.summary: Emulator save-state system. Snapshot storage in Supabase.

patches.name: Patch 10 — Core Unification
patches.summary: Unify GB/GBC/GBA cores under single adapter interface.

patches.name: Patch 11 — TRON Frontend
patches.summary: WASM emulator runtime + ES-DE-style launcher + TRON navigation layer.

patches.name: Patch 12 — Intelligence + Multiplayer + Temporal Replay
patches.summary: AI guidance overlay, multiplayer session sync, full replay engine.

patches.name: Patch 13 — God System Governance Pipeline
patches.summary: Full 27-node God System pipeline visible in GRID. AYRE→AEGIS→ODIN→KRONOS→SKADI→MNEMOS→HUGINN flow UI.

patches.name: Patch 14 — God Stats / Power Model
patches.summary: Per-node stat model: entropy, load, alignment, power. node_fields table already deployed from P05.
patches.notes: node_fields Supabase table already exists — this patch adds the stat computation layer.

patches.name: Patch 15 — Multimodal Layer
patches.summary: Text adventure overlay. Image + text hybrid view in TRON navigation layer.

patches.name: Patch 16 — Clean Hierarchy
patches.summary: Briefing-aware hierarchy cleanup. Patch stack load order enforcement on boot.

patches.name: Patch 17 — Audit + Log System
patches.summary: Immutable audit_log + patch_log Supabase tables. GitHub Actions auto-log workflow. patch_ledger.json canonical tracker.
patches.notes: Tables live and seeded. GitHub Actions workflow requires SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY secret to be added in repo settings.

patches.name: Patch 18 — Intelligence Growth Registry
patches.summary: Agent capability registry. Per-session intelligence growth tracking.

patches.name: Patch 19 — Quantum GRID Realm
patches.summary: 4D lattice structure. Folded space compression. L3-L6 GRID kernel layers. Per P00: GRID = view projection — quantum framing is conceptual.

patches.name: Patch 20 — Stable Controller / Drift Elimination
patches.summary: Control plane. Drift detection triggers event bus alerts. HUGINN reconciliation on mismatch.

patches.name: Patch 21 — Execution Identity Layer
patches.summary: Briefing-first boot sequence. All agents = JARVIS instances in role mode. AEGIS gate on all outputs. Traceability mandate.
patches.notes: Boot sequence implemented: loadBriefing() fetches JarvisBriefing from GitHub raw → AYRE/AEGIS/ODIN/state-sync lines on boot → briefingLoaded status dot in menu header → BOOT event logged to events table. Remaining: AEGIS gate on all outputs (P22 territory), explicit role-mode tagging.
remaining: AEGIS output gate — wrap all sbEvent/draw calls with constraint check
Role-mode identity tagging — agent metadata per session

patches.name: Patch 22 — Live Runtime Mesh
patches.summary: Replay engine + event bus + cartridge standard + push sync. System becomes fully replayable like a save-state engine.

patches.name: Patch 23 — GRID/TRON Substrate Split
patches.summary: GRID = internal state kernel (L0-L6 layers). TRON = navigation/UI shell. Clean separation of substrate from interface.
